name: Blockbuster Mango magic
ingredients: Inner layer - Ice Cream (70%): Added Water, Milk Solids, Sugar, Mango Pulp (9.6%), Emulsifiers (INS 471, INS 433) and Stabilizers (INS 466, INS 412, INS 407a, INS 410), Artificial (Mango) Flavoring Substances, Synthetic Food Colours (INS 110, INS 102, INS 124). Outer Layer - White Compound Covering (30%): Refined Palm Kernel Oil, Sugar, Milk Solids, Refined Palm Oil, Emulsifier (INS 322), Natural Colour (160b), Artificial (Mango) Flavoring Substances.
